description.en:
The parameter type. Valid values:

- **normal**: Not encrypted.
- **md5**: MD5-encrypted.

description.zh:
车牌号

> 
> - 当paramType取值normal时，输入明文。
> -  当paramType取值md5时，输入车牌号除最后两位的其他部分明文+车牌最后两位字母MD5加密（32位小写MD5）
description.en:
The license plate number.

> 
> - If ParamType is set to normal, enter the plaintext value.
> - If ParamType is set to md5, enter the plaintext of the license plate number excluding the last two characters, concatenated with the MD5-encrypted last two characters (32-bit lowercase MD5).

description.zh:
车辆类型

> 
> - 02-普通小客车
> - 52-新能源小客车
description.en:
The vehicle type.

> 
> - 02: standard passenger car
> - 52: new energy passenger car.

descriptions.zh: 通过车牌号、车辆类型，查询车辆基本信息
descriptions.en: Queries basic vehicle information by license plate number and vehicle type.
